title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Default Servicing Charges: Short-Sale Foreclosure Carry
content:
Short-sale foreclosure carry — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction default servicing charges

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale foreclosure carry enters the short-sale accrual basis.

*Inputs:* the status and the referral date of the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, and the statement date.

*Judgement:*
- Referred to foreclosure, with the referral date at least 30 calendar days before the statement date: USD 2525.00, the full foreclosure charges.
- Referred to foreclosure, referred fewer than 30 days before the statement date: USD 875.00, the initial foreclosure charges. A case with no referral date counts as referred 0 days before.
- Any other status: nothing (0.00).

*Hypothetical boundary:* a referral dated exactly 30 days before the statement date gives USD 2525.00; one dated 29 days before gives USD 875.00.
